records.academicNote: Engineering/Science bachelor or assessed professional equivalent; OTHER undergraduate disciplines require at least TWO years of relevant POST-QUALIFICATION experience. This is an alternative academic route, not a universal two-year work minimum. No automatic equivalence or major-to-experience inference.
records.documentNote: Upload transcript/supporting scans for review; shortlisted applicants may be asked for hard copies. A 100-based score should be reported on its actual scale where the school uses it, not converted to 4.0. General and departmental English/degree alternatives need university assessment.

records.academicNote: Relevant Engineering, Science or Medical degree OR assessed equivalent professional qualification OR another first degree with appropriate biomedical/science/technology background. Department also states honours/equivalence and extensive related content; panel assessment is needed. Biomedical engineering is not a clinical licence.
records.documentNote: Department requires transcripts/grading scheme, degree certificate, applicable English proof, TWO confidential references and ID evidence. Personal Statement and CV are explicitly NOT REQUIRED, though optional for reference. Electronic official proof from issuing offices or sealed official transcripts may be accepted as described. Conditional project/graduate awards are post-entry, not guaranteed entry discounts.

records.academicNote: Computer Science, Computer Engineering or related degree is the normal route; the department additionally permits assessed equivalent professional qualifications OR another degree with extensive COMPUTER-RELATED CONTENT. Do not reject every non-CS graduate. Distance/short-duration overseas degrees may require HKCAAVQ assessment.
records.documentNote: Upload transcripts/grading scheme, degree evidence if graduated, applicable Mainland CHSI verifications, English evidence and identity document. TWO references are explicitly OPTIONAL on the current CS procedure page, not mandatory. An old FAQ TOEFL/waiver formulation and visa-fee quote are not automatically imported as current policy.

records.academicNote: Engineering, Science, Business Administration/Management or related degree, normally Second Class Honours OR average B; OR assessed equivalent related professional qualification. No numeric GPA conversion or invented universal work-year minimum.
records.documentNote: Upload scanned transcript/supporting proof; shortlisted candidates may be asked to mail hard copies. Department 2019 FAQ says GPA is assessed case by case; it is dated guidance, not a current numeric floor. Visa pages are dated 2025; processing-time statements are not promised personal outcomes.

records.academicNote: Electrical/Electronic/Information/Computer Engineering degree is the preferred normal background; Physics, Mechanical Engineering and other fields may also be considered with electronic-engineering experience/background. No mandatory work-year count. September FT; department also mentions a provisional January PT intake, but its cohort/date/price applicability is unresolved: this batch represents SEPTEMBER only.
records.documentNote: Upload scanned proof for review. Hard copies are not required before a conditional MSc offer; only shortlisted applicants are asked to mail proof afterwards. Do not require every applicant to send originals immediately. No mandatory referee count was established in this selected panel.

records.academicNote: Mathematics (calculus, linear algebra, probability), a modern programming language supported by transcript, and Engineering/Science/Mathematics/Finance/Business degree or equivalent are worded PREFERABLY in the MSc entry panel. Do not turn preferences into hard skill/major failures or copy PGD entry rules/15-credit price. Course, Practicum and Industrial Project tracks remain curricular choices of ONE MSc.
records.documentNote: Current FAQ says NO interview and NO GRE required. Upload scans first; no original hard copies at initial stage, shortlisted applicants may later be asked for proof. Conditional HKD80,000 admission scholarships have a maximum five awards and ongoing-registration conditions; no automatic fee deduction. The nearby PGD is outside this master-only batch.

records.academicNote: Engineering/Science/related degree OR related professional equivalent OR another degree with relevant courses or IT-industry experience. A named field alone does not prove equivalence. Two referees required in current department procedure; scans initially, hard copies may be requested for shortlisted applicants.
records.documentNote: Engineering/Science/related degree OR related professional equivalent OR another degree with relevant courses or IT-industry experience. boundaries.fees: Six programmes have explicit2027/28 panels; five unlabelled GS fee quotes remain numeric null. CS financial approval caveat retained, not a programme-admission pending status.

boundaries.redirects: MAE/Robotics initial bodies are meta-refresh only, contentReadable false; actual explicit www4 targets were read, and old fee years retained. No guessed URL or challenge bypass.
boundaries.scope: Financial Technology PGD panel was read only to separate it from MSc. It does not become another master or a guaranteed transfer; optional research/practicum/project tracks do not create new degree IDs.
boundaries.gpa: General Second Class OR average B OR professional-equivalence alternatives stay manual, without numeric GPA conversion or a universal honours-only failure.
boundaries.https: Six observed legacy HTTP source URLs were actually fetched over HTTPS and verified before current product citations were changed; transport/old observations retained. Loader official-source policy not relaxed.
